nextSteps: Get bundle ID: mobilebuildmcp simulator get-app-bundle-id --app-path <TMPDIR>/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/CalculatorApp.app
Boot simulator: mobilebuildmcp simulator boot --simulator-id SIMULATOR_UUID
Install app: mobilebuildmcp simulator install --simulator-id SIMULATOR_UUID --app-path <TMPDIR>/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/CalculatorApp.app
Launch app: mobilebuildmcp simulator launch-app --simulator-id SIMULATOR_UUID --bundle-id BUNDLE_ID
